slice: RPP-5kr selected append from a four-element consumed MLINESTYLE
scope: Generalizes consumed MLINESTYLE append admission from a two-element-only source to source counts of at least two, below 255, with a larger target count no greater than 255. This receipt qualifies the selected AC1027 four-element source to five-element target profile. It does not claim every source-count combination, other geometry or native semantic support.

references.use: Group 73 is the MLINESTYLE element count; group 74 gives repeated per-vertex parameter counts; group 41 carries the parameters and group 75/42 carry area-fill counts and values.
Group 49 carries MLINESTYLE element offsets. The selected projection remains limited to the admitted flag and angle profile.

contract.admission: The source style has four elements and is already consumed by source-bound ordinary MLINEs. The target appends exactly one complete tuple, yielding five. Original style body, dictionary/provider graph and all consumers are bound. Original tuples and fields remain unchanged; the appended tuple has finite offset -2.5, ACI 6 and ByLayer linetype. Source and target flags are 2 with equal angles. Consumers remain live, in original scope and model-identical during preflight. The implementation guard supports source counts 2..254 and targets through 255, but this receipt qualifies only source count four and target count five.
contract.geometry: Both source consumers are open, uncut and unfilled, have three vertices, positive finite scale, center/bottom justification, unit extrusion and source-consistent WCS positions, directions and miters. The four source group-41 pairs per vertex are validated against the original offsets [1.25,-0.75,-1.25,-2.0]. Output projection has five pairs per vertex recomputed against target offsets [1.25,-0.75,-1.25,-2.0,-2.5]. Bottom justification uses the new +2.5 shift. Every pair has zero second value; group 42 is absent and group 75 counts are zero.
contract.identityAndOutput: The MLINESTYLE retains OLD_BODY_NAME and emits group 71 = 5, all five group-49 offsets, the flag color plus five element ACI values, and the five element linetype names. Unique ByLayer and Continuous LTYPE providers are checked under the LTYPE TABLE with their handles and owner fields. Each consumer retains OLD_ENTITY_NAME and group 340 to the emitted style handle, with group 73 = 5, fifteen group-74 values of 2, thirty group-41 values, fifteen zero group-75 values and no group 42. Fresh import verifies all tuple fields, consumer counts, arrays, geometry vectors, scale and extrusion for model-space and named-block MLINEs.
contract.failureAndRetry: An unsupported style flag refuses before publication and preserves destination and caller state; correcting the flag allows same-adapter retry. A late mutation of a live consumer's original parameter array refuses before publication; restoring the caller snapshot allows same-adapter retry. Both failure types are exercised with ASCII and binary output; the successful matrix crosses ASCII/binary source and output.
contract.compatibility: No public API or DRW_Interface virtual changes. All source drawings are generated at runtime from scratch and removed on success; no drawing fixtures are committed.
contract.limits: The selected source is AC1027 with four style elements, offsets [1.25,-0.75,-1.25,-2.0], flags 2, equal angles, two open uncut unfilled consumers, and one appended element. ASCII and binary sources are crossed with ASCII and binary output. It does not qualify other source counts, multi-element append from a four-element source, removals, composed edits, other MLINE schemas/carriers/versions, native CAD rendering, document closure or independent 3D semantics. No support claim is promoted.

controls.sourceProfile: The generated four-element source has offsets [1.25,-0.75,-1.25,-2.0], ACI [1,3,4,5] and alternating ByLayer/Continuous providers. The added tuple is (-2.5, ACI 6, ByLayer). The target minimum is -2.5; all old and new per-vertex parameters are checked against that complete target offset set.
controls.failureAndRetry: Four successful source/output profiles and eight successful readbacks total; two invalid-flag refusals and two late-consumer mutation refusals preserve destination/caller state; four same-adapter retries succeed after correction.

toolchains.normal: GNU C++ at /usr/bin/g++; no explicit CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE or CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS
